adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-review closed the local worker-2 and worker-5 artifact-shape blockers while preserving database cautions and source-locator provenance.

caution_findings.finding: DBAASP rows use legacy pEM-2 derivative names while the primary article names the peptides S1, S1-Nal, and S1-Nal-Nal; the synonym relationship is preserved with Table 1 and introduction locators.
Database X/U notation for Nal is mapped to the primary article Nal residue notation and retained as modified-sequence evidence, not normalized to an ordinary amino acid.
CAMP/dbAMP rows are entry-level activity summaries with PubMed linkage; they are supported by primary identity/MIC tables but are not promoted to individual assay rows.
Ten local supplementary_original .bin files were opened and identified as Frontiers HTML landing captures; extracted supplementary table count remains zero.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded owner-worker re-review used only indexed local materials and preserved unsupported facts as cautions/gaps.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Database audit remains source-reviewed; existing caution findings are preserved without status promotion.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Activity rows now expose required top-level endpoint, value, unit, target, condition, statistic-status, and locator fields from source-backed table rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims now use allowed ontology classes with direct-assay types for direct claims and inference-only classification for contextual claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: Local supplementary/package checks were reopened through the packet index; no unsupported value was fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_decision: Publication-grade acceptance with cautions is supportable after closing local rework targets.
